articles.title: China hits out at 'illegal' new US sanctions on Iran and trading partners
articles.description: The US has threatened to isolate nations that continue to do business with Tehran, which sells much of its oil to Beijing.

articles.title: Israel warns of 'forceful' response to kites flown from Gaza
articles.description: Hamas says the kites found in Israeli border communities in recent days were launched by children in Gaza.

articles.title: UK drone factories may face attacks from 'unknown sources', says former Russian minister
articles.description: The comments on BBC Newsnight come after the UK announced it has agreed to hand over blueprints for British-made missile components to Ukraine.

articles.title: No one held accountable one year after Israeli double strike on Gaza hospital
articles.description: A year on from an Israeli double strike on a hospital in Gaza that killed 22 Palestinians, including journalists and rescue workers, no one has been held accountable.

articles.title: Canada announces retaliatory tariffs - as trade war with US heats up
articles.description: Canada has said it will impose new tariffs on US imports as a trade war between the neighbours heats up.

articles.title: Canadian politician threatens to cut off electricity to the US - as Trump issues 'fall in line' warning
articles.description: A Canadian politician has threatened to cut off electricity and mineral supplies to the US after President Trump raised tariffs on some goods to 50%.
